question: Do pulse-minus-sham responses converge when all grids start from identical complete states, and how strongly do those responses depend on reference RMDL phase?
fixed: All weights, channel/physiology parameters, initial-state rule, pulse amplitude/reversal, model implementation; float64. No fitting, peptide term or body dynamics.
anchors: Each model settles60s with0.03125ms neural step; then record1s at1ms intervals. Select first complete RMDL peak-to-peak cycle using fixed1mV prominence/20ms minimum separation; save full voltage, gates, calcium and indicator at phases0,1/4,1/2,3/4, rounded to1ms samples. Reuse the exact saved states across every tested step. Phase reference is model/grid-specific, not an independently converged attractor or a constraint on RMDR phase.
target_selection: A priori subset from E106/E107 pinned first13; no response-based target/model reselection, no atlas accuracy claim.
trials: Three pulses plus two duplicate zero-drive shams per phase/model/grid. Pulse0.5s at original E107 amplitude and0mV reversal; horizon12s, fixed1ms output/accumulation; mean indicator over1.5..11.5s. Save all-cell full states at20ms and RMD voltage trajectories for pulse/sham conditions, means and differences. No full-brain long trajectory archive.
checks: Automatic post-run audit verifies copied model and anchor hashes, exact states reused, all planned cases, float64/finite arrays, duplicate-sham response<=1e-12, input/artifact hashes before/after, no parameter changes, execution budget. Report short-horizon errors separately for voltage/gates/calcium/indicator without new physiological thresholds. Apply existing atlas relative-error<0.1/correlation>=0.9 criteria to each phase and phase-mean responses, requiring both finest consecutive pairs. Phase-average is a prospectively declared diagnostic, not a replacement for original atlas failures or a biological observable. No automatic model promotion.
limits: Does not establish phase as sole cause, independent-solver truth, full-atlas accuracy, biological fidelity, autonomous body movement or sensory start/stop. Failure/incomplete remains explicit.
budget: Maximum120minutes TOTAL including automatic audit; two A100 workers, one fixed model each; nohup. May finish earlier.
